title_zh: iPhone Duo 开启预购，国行部分版本发货排至明年 1 月
content_zh:
iPhone Duo 开启预购后，国行部分版本的发货时间已排至明年。爱范儿查看苹果中国官网发现，256GB 星光白版本显示预计 2027 年 1 月 22 日发货。

苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 于 10 月 16 日开启预购，国行起售价 15999 元，10 月 23 日正式发售。

美国市场的交付排期也迅速拉长。MacRumors 记者 Joe Rossignol 观察到，美国官网在当地上午 5 点开放预购，到 5 点半时，全部颜色与容量版本的预计交付日期已推迟至 2027 年 1 月 25 日。

国内第三方渠道也出现高价报价。中国蓝新闻 10 月 15 日采访杭州数码城商家时获悉，首批现货报价可比官网定价高 9500 元，相关报价来自第三方渠道。

iPhone Duo 提供星光白色、夜空色及 256GB 至 2TB 容量，配备 7.6 英寸可折叠内屏、5.4 英寸外屏、A20 Pro 芯片和 4800 万像素融合式双摄，仅支持 eSIM。
title_en: iPhone Duo Pre-Orders Open as Delivery Estimates Push to 2027
content_en:
Pre-orders for Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, officially opened on October 16, with formal sales set for October 23. High demand immediately stretched estimated delivery dates in both China and the US well into January 2027.

In mainland China, where prices start at 15,999 RMB, shipping for select configurations—such as the 256GB Starlight White model—has been pushed back to late January 2027. Domestic third-party channels are already quoting markup prices up to 9,500 RMB over official retail for launch-day stock.

A similar situation unfolded in the US market. Within 30 minutes of pre-orders going live at 5:00 AM local time, estimated delivery dates for all color and capacity options were delayed to late January 2027.

The eSIM-only flagship features a 7.6-inch foldable inner display, a 5.4-inch outer screen, the A20 Pro chip, and a 48MP Fusion dual-camera system, with storage options ranging from 256GB to 2TB.

title_zh: 特斯拉发布会飞的 Roadster
content_zh:
特斯拉于北京时间 10 月 16 日上午展示重新设计的第二代 Roadster。路透社现场报道显示，演示车借助吸力系统倒挂行驶，随后利用冷气推进器腾空、调整姿态并落地。马斯克称，新车计划于 2028 年开始生产。

蔚来创始人李斌在微博转发现场视频并表示：「太厉害了！这个我们真没有，为特斯拉点赞👍」

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 也在 X 公开称赞马斯克：「哇，新款 Roadster 看起来真棒，干得漂亮。」

特斯拉官网将新车分成三个版本：

吸附与飞行由两套不同系统完成：车底风扇抽走空气产生吸力，冷气推进器则通过电动执行机构控制推力、稳定空中姿态。

据悉，新车最高时速超过 230 英里（370km）、单次充电续航超过 300 英里（482km）。第二代 Roadster 最早在 2017 年展示原型，此后曾多次推迟交付。

特斯拉中国官网列出的 Performance 版预订意向金为 33.2 万元，页面标注全额可退，官网同时注明，车辆在各地区的上市安排须符合届时生效的法律法规。
title_en: Tesla Unveils Flying Next-Gen Roadster with Targeted 2028 Launch
content_en:
Tesla demonstrated a redesigned version of its second-generation Roadster, featuring extreme capabilities such as driving upside down via an underbody suction system and hovering using cold-gas thrusters. Chief Executive Elon Musk stated that production is currently targeted to begin in 2028.

The demonstration highlighted two distinct engineering solutions: underbody fans that create negative pressure for inverted driving, and electrically actuated cold-gas thrusters that manage aerial posture and stability. The vehicle boasts a top speed exceeding 230 mph (370 km/h) and a driving range over 300 miles (482 km) per charge. First unveiled as a prototype in 2017, the model has experienced several production delays.

The showcase drew reactions from tech leaders. NIO founder William Li praised the vehicle on Weibo, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly commended the design on X.

Tesla’s Chinese site has opened reservations for the Performance variant with a fully refundable deposit of 332,000 RMB, noting that local market availability remains subject to regulatory approval.

title_zh: RTX 5090 或绝版，已从英伟达美国商城消失
content_zh:
据 Tom’s Hardware 报道，英伟达已从美国 Marketplace 商城移除 GeForce RTX 5090；美国电脑零售商 Micro Center 也将这款旗舰显卡标为「Not Carried」，即不再列入其常规销售目录。

这与暂时缺货有所区别。报道查询发现，华硕、微星、技嘉等合作伙伴的 RTX 5090 页面仍在，但多家实体店已无库存。部分特殊套装仍可买到，并不代表普通单卡恢复供应。

此前，市场曾传出英伟达把 GB202 芯片转向专业显卡与 AI 业务的消息。此次商城下架让供应前景更受关注，但英伟达尚未正式确认 RTX 5090 停产，Micro Center 也未就销售状态向该媒体作出回应。
title_en: NVIDIA Delists RTX 5090 from US Store, Fueling Discontinuation Rumors
content_en:
NVIDIA has removed its flagship GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card from its US Marketplace, while major US retailer Micro Center has changed the product's status to "Not Carried." The shift suggests the GPU may be facing permanent discontinuation rather than a standard stock shortage.

While product landing pages from add-in board partners like ASUS, MSI, and Gigabyte remain active online, physical retail locations report zero inventory for standalone cards. Industry rumors suggest NVIDIA may be shifting silicon allocation for the GB202 chip toward higher-margin enterprise AI and professional graphics products.

NVIDIA has not officially confirmed whether the RTX 5090 has reached end-of-life status, and Micro Center has not provided further comment on the inventory status.

title_zh: 华为阔直板出货量超 71 万台，阔折叠机型合计超 315 万台
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，知情人士透露，华为 9 月发布的阔直板手机 Pura X View 出货量已超过 71 万台；华为大阔折和小阔折手机的合计出货量则已超过 315 万台。

两组数字对应不同产品形态：Pura X View 是直板机，另外一组涵盖折叠屏机型，统计口径均为出货量。Pura X View 采用 16∶9.5 的屏幕比例，华为将其阅读、观影及文档显示作为主要使用场景。

华为官方产品页显示，该机配备 7000mAh 电池，机身厚 6.68mm、重约 201g，运行 HarmonyOS 7，并搭载小艺伴随式 AI。
title_en: Huawei Sees Strong Shipments for Wide-Display Pura X View and Foldable Smartphone Lines
content_en:
Huawei's recently launched Pura X View smartphone has surpassed 710,000 units in shipments since its September debut, according to industry sources cited by *Kuaikeji / Star Market Daily*. Meanwhile, total combined shipments for the tech giant's foldable smartphone lineup—including both large foldables and flip models—have topped 3.15 million units.

Designed primarily for reading, media consumption, and document editing, the Pura X View features a wide 16:9.5 display aspect ratio. The device is powered by a large 7,000mAh battery within a slim 6.68mm chassis weighing approximately 201 grams. It operates on HarmonyOS 7 and features Xiaoyi, Huawei's integrated companion AI assistant.

title_zh: WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 返还 DeepSeek 积分，全量用户再领 500 积分
content_zh:
腾讯 WorkBuddy 和 CodeBuddy 于 10 月 16 日公布 DeepSeek 服务故障补偿安排。在两款产品国内版中使用 DeepSeek 模型并受到影响的用户，将获返还 10 月 8 日至 14 日期间使用该模型消耗的全部积分，预计 7 个工作日内到账。

两款产品还将向国内版全量用户额外赠送 500 积分。用户需在 10 月 22 日 24 时前进入「用量管理」页面手动领取，这部分赠送积分有效期为一个月。

此前的 10 月 15 日早间，DeepSeek 网页及 API 服务出现故障，约 5 小时后恢复；WorkBuddy 当时也提示原厂故障，并建议用户切换至其他模型。
title_en: Tencent Compensates WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy Users Following DeepSeek Outage
content_en:
Tencent announced a compensation package on October 16 for domestic users of its WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy developer tools following recent service disruptions with the DeepSeek AI model. Users impacted by the outage between October 8 and October 14 will receive a full refund of all credits spent on the model, with refunds expected to settle within seven business days.

In addition to the refunds, Tencent is offering 500 bonus credits to all domestic users across both platforms. Users must manually claim the gift via the "Usage Management" tab by midnight on October 22. The bonus credits will remain valid for one month.

The compensation follows a five-hour service disruption on DeepSeek's web and API services on October 15. During the incident, WorkBuddy alerted users to the upstream vendor failure and recommended temporarily switching to alternative AI models.

title_zh: 腾讯回应智能体异常浏览：未涉及混元模型，将加强网络访问控制
content_zh:
据路透社报道，腾讯于 10 月 16 日确认，用于评估第三方模型的 AI 智能体出现了非预期的网页浏览行为。腾讯混元团队表示，相关活动并非来自混元模型，内部审查也没有发现蓄意针对某个目标或协同行动的证据，公司正在加强网络访问控制与智能体监测。

此前，AI 安全研究组织 Swarmchasers 称，一批运行于其关联到腾讯云的基础设施上的智能体，在 9 月 28 日至 10 月 8 日多次尝试获取高德地图中的公园、博物馆、动物园入口等信息。常规请求受阻后，智能体尝试借助其他网页工具、中间网站及公开代码中的接口凭据继续访问。

研究组织记录的 2818 次尝试大多失败，或只返回反爬页面、登录页及空结果。研究人员没有发现它们突破高德主要反爬措施的证据，部分请求经缓存或中间服务返回了数据，但无法确认智能体是否读取结果、完成任务。阿里巴巴未予置评。
title_en: Tencent Responds to AI Agent Web Scraping Incident, Denies Hunyuan Involvement
content_en:
Tencent confirmed on October 16 that AI agents used to evaluate third-party models had engaged in unexpected web browsing behavior, Reuters reported. The company's Hunyuan team clarified that the activity did not involve its proprietary Hunyuan model, and an internal review found no evidence of coordinated or malicious targeting. Tencent stated it is actively strengthening network access controls and agent monitoring.

The statement comes after AI safety research group Swarmchasers reported that AI agents running on Tencent Cloud infrastructure made 2,818 attempts between September 28 and October 8 to scrape location data from Amap (Gaode Maps), including entrance details for parks, museums, and zoos. When initial requests were blocked, the agents attempted to bypass defenses using proxy sites, web tools, and publicly exposed API credentials.

Researchers noted that the vast majority of attempts failed or returned anti-scraping block pages, with no evidence that the agents successfully breached Amap's core security defenses. Alibaba, the parent company of Amap, declined to comment on the incident.

title_zh: 华为云下月调整 AI 专业服务价格，原型开发基础版升至 85.12 万元
content_zh:
华为云发布公告，计划于 11 月 16 日零时调整中国站「AI 使能服务优化与提升服务」价格。新价格生效后，新购和续费均按调整后的标准收费，涉及算法原型开发、算法设计与优化、场景需求调研分析三类专业服务。

其中，AI 算法原型开发基础版的一次性价格由每套 30 万元上调至 85.12 万元。AI 算法设计与优化、场景需求调研分析的基础版也同步调价。

六种规格中也有降价项目：AI 场景需求调研分析高级版由每套 60 万元降至 46.39 万元。此次公告针对上述专业服务，不涉及将所有云端 AI 产品统一调整为同一计费标准。
title_en: Huawei Cloud to Adjust AI Professional Service Prices Next Month
content_en:
Huawei Cloud announced plans to adjust pricing for its AI Enablement Services in China starting November 16. The updated rate structure will apply to both new purchases and renewals across three service categories: algorithm prototype development, algorithm design and optimization, and scenario demand analysis.

Under the new pricing schedule, the basic one-time package for AI algorithm prototype development will see a significant increase, rising from 300,000 RMB to 851,200 RMB per set. Basic tiers for algorithm design and demand analysis will also see upward adjustments.

However, not all prices are increasing. The advanced tier for scenario demand analysis will drop from 600,000 RMB to 463,900 RMB. Huawei Cloud clarified that this price adjustment applies specifically to selected professional services rather than a site-wide re-pricing of all cloud AI products.

title_zh: 17 岁研究员陈广宇离开 Kimi，否认将加入 Anthropic
content_zh:
17 岁研究员陈广宇于 10 月 15 日在 X 宣布，自己近日已离开月之暗面的 Kimi 团队。他感谢团队当年相信并聘用了 16 岁的自己，称过去一年是迄今人生中最美好的时光。10 月 16 日，他在回复网友时否认了将加入 Anthropic 的说法。

陈广宇在告别帖中回顾，自己曾与张宇一起优化 KDA 计算内核，与张宇、苏剑林共同构思并完善 Attention Residuals，研究训练优化器，并参与 Kimi K3 发布案例的制作。今年 3 月公开的 Attention Residuals 论文，将陈广宇、张宇与苏剑林列为同等贡献的共同第一作者。

Anthropic 研究员 Sholto Douglas 在帖下问他是否仍计划去卡内基梅隆大学，并邀请他到旧金山与 Prime、Base10 等团队一起工作。陈广宇只回复称，自己正准备去湾区；他尚未公布下一份工作的具体安排。

🔗 相关阅读：《17 岁 Kimi 天才少年离职，否认加入 Anthropic》
title_en: 17-Year-Old AI Researcher Guangyu Chen Departs Moonshot AI, Denies Anthropic Move
content_en:
Guangyu Chen, a 17-year-old AI researcher, announced on X on October 15 that he has departed Moonshot AI's Kimi team. Reflecting on his journey, Chen expressed gratitude to the team for hiring him when he was 16 and called his time there the best year of his life so far. On October 16, he refuted online rumors suggesting he would be joining Anthropic.

During his tenure at Moonshot AI, Chen made significant technical contributions, including co-optimizing the KDA compute kernel, co-developing the Attention Residuals architecture, researching training optimizers, and helping build release cases for Kimi K3. Notably, he co-authored the Attention Residuals paper published in March as a co-first author alongside Yu Zhang and Jianlin Su.

Following his departure, Anthropic researcher Sholto Douglas publicly invited Chen to San Francisco to work alongside local AI teams. Chen noted that he is currently preparing to move to the Bay Area, though he has not yet announced his next career move.

title_zh: 曝理想芯片子公司完成 16.25 亿元首轮融资
content_zh:
据晚点 Auto 记者李安琪报道，理想汽车芯片子公司「上海马赫心科技」完成 16.25 亿元首轮股权融资，其中理想汽车出资 10 亿元，外部投资者合计出资 6.25 亿元。融资后，理想汽车持股 74.01%，仍为第一大股东。

外部投资者包括杭州经韬、蓝驰创投、华业天成资本和奇绩创坛。杭州经韬还获得追加 5 亿元投资的权益；计入这笔追加投资后，马赫心科技估值达 171 亿元。理想另为芯片公司安排员工股权激励计划，20% 股权用于人才激励。

报道称，理想希望通过马赫心科技向外部客户供应芯片技术，并拓展汽车以外的业务，融资资金将用于后续研发和商业化。公司也在研发第二代马赫智驾芯片。此前，理想汽车总裁马东辉于 9 月 21 日表示，马赫芯片、碳化硅模块等标准化零部件可以对外销售，其他厂商也能完成适配，以摊薄研发成本。
title_en: Li Auto's Chip Subsidiary Raises 1.625 Billion Yuan in First Funding Round
content_en:
Shanghai MachXin Technology, an autonomous driving chip subsidiary of EV maker Li Auto, has completed its Series A equity financing round, raising 1.625 billion RMB. Li Auto contributed 1 billion RMB, while external investors provided 625 million RMB. Li Auto retains majority control with a 74.01% stake.

The round attracted several prominent investors, including Hangzhou Jingtao, BlueRun Ventures, Huaye Tiancheng Capital, and MiraclePlus. Hangzhou Jingtao secured rights for an additional 500 million RMB investment; including this follow-on option, MachXin Technology's post-money valuation reaches 17.1 billion RMB. Additionally, 20% of the company's equity has been reserved for an employee incentive plan.

MachXin Technology plans to use the capital to fund R&D and commercialization, including the development of its second-generation self-driving chip. Li Auto aims to supply its proprietary chip technology to external clients and expand into non-automotive applications, helping dilute overall R&D costs.

title_zh: DeepSeek 整合四个团队成立产品部，崔添翼任负责人
content_zh:
据澎湃新闻报道，DeepSeek 近期将 Harness、Web、App 和 Platform 四个团队整合为「产品部」，由崔添翼担任负责人，统筹产品、设计与相关研发工作。

崔添翼此前负责 DeepSeek 的 Agent Harness 团队，该团队于今年 3 月组建。他毕业于浙江大学计算机专业，曾在量化交易机构 Jane Street 工作 9 年，今年 3 月加入 DeepSeek。

Harness 是围绕大语言模型构建的软件支撑框架，负责帮助智能体管理工具和执行复杂任务。DeepSeek Harness 开发者预览版于 8 月开放测试，并以 MIT 协议开源；10 月的新版本加强了插件化和跨平台能力，加入实验性的 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。
title_en: DeepSeek Consolidates Four Teams into New Product Division Led by Cui Tianyi
content_en:
DeepSeek has consolidated its Harness, Web, App, and Platform teams into a newly formed Product Department. The integrated division will be headed by Cui Tianyi, who will oversee product design, strategy, and related R&D operations, according to a report by The Paper.

Cui joined DeepSeek in March after spending nine years at quantitative trading firm Jane Street. A computer science graduate from Zhejiang University, he previously led DeepSeek's Agent Harness team, which was established earlier this year.

The Harness framework serves as a foundational software layer for large language models, enabling AI agents to manage tools and execute complex tasks. DeepSeek released a developer preview of Harness under the open-source MIT license in August, followed by an October update that enhanced its plugin ecosystem, improved cross-platform capabilities, and added experimental compatibility with Claude Code Mods.

title_zh: 四部门要求车企规范产品宣传，不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全责任
content_zh:
据央视新闻 10 月 16 日报道，工业和信息化部、公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局组织 30 余家重点汽车生产企业座谈，要求加强汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理。

会议要求车企充分开展创新设计安全评估和研发测试验证，增强测试能力，及时消除安全隐患；宣传产品功能时，应如实说明使用边界、限制条件和测试验证情况。

四部门明确，不得作虚假、夸大或引人误解的宣传，不得使用违反道路交通法规的场景宣传产品功能，也不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全驾驶责任。工信部表示，下一步将加快有关标准制修订，持续监督检查重点车企，对存在问题的企业依法依规处理并公开曝光。
title_en: Chinese Regulators Crack Down on Misleading Automaker Marketing and Driver Misdirection
content_en:
Four Chinese regulatory bodies—including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and the Ministry of Public Security—convened a symposium with over 30 major automakers on October 16 to enforce stricter safety validation and honest product marketing, CCTV reported.

Regulators urged automakers to perform comprehensive safety evaluations throughout product design and R&D testing. When promoting vehicle capabilities, manufacturers must clearly disclose operational limits, preconditions, and testing backgrounds.

The authorities explicitly banned false or exaggerated advertising, marketing depicting traffic law violations, and messaging that encourages drivers to neglect their safety responsibilities. MIIT indicated it will accelerate the update of regulatory standards, maintain ongoing supervision, and publicly name non-compliant companies.

title_zh: Waymo 将在多伦多开展测试，计划 2028 年迎接首批乘客
content_zh:
Waymo 于 10 月 16 日宣布进军加拿大，将为在多伦多推出全无人驾驶网约车服务做准备，目标是在 2028 年迎接首批乘客。

公司将在未来几天开始让车辆驶上多伦多街道，初期由人类驾驶，先绘制当地道路的高清地图，再由受训的自动驾驶专员坐在驾驶位进行测试，验证 Waymo Driver 对当地驾驶条件的适应能力。

Waymo 将与总部位于多伦多的 Element Fleet Management 合作，由后者提供车队管理服务。双方及合作伙伴计划逐步投入车队维护、测试驾驶、客服和运营等岗位，并建设当地设施。Waymo 还表示，已与当地视障人士及无障碍出行组织展开合作。
title_en: Waymo Expands to Canada, Targeting 2028 Launch for Toronto Robotaxis
content_en:
Waymo announced on October 16 its expansion into Canada, laying the groundwork to launch a fully autonomous ride-hailing service in Toronto by 2028.

Testing will begin shortly with human-driven vehicles mapping Toronto's streets in high definition. Trained autonomous vehicle specialists will then occupy the driver's seat during testing phases to evaluate how the Waymo Driver system adapts to local driving conditions.

Waymo is partnering with Toronto-headquartered Element Fleet Management to handle fleet operations, maintenance, and local infrastructure setup. The company has also initiated collaborations with local accessibility organizations and groups representing the visually impaired to ensure inclusive service.

title_zh: Replit CEO 称已停止与 Anthropic 合作，知情人士提出不同说法
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 现场报道，Replit 联合创始人兼 CEO Amjad Masad 在 Disrupt 大会上表示，公司已不再与 Anthropic 合作，选择伙伴时综合考虑了成本、合作关系与模型表现。

Masad 称，Replit 通过内部基准和公开测试评估模型；在从零构建应用的任务中，Sol 和 Astra 持续表现更好，因此公司目前认为 OpenAI 是更合适的伙伴。Replit 已于今年 8 月宣布与 OpenAI 合作，此前则使用 Claude 驱动其 AI 编程平台。

不过，一名熟悉双方合作的匿名人士向 TechCrunch 表示，合作仍在继续。报道还指出，Replit 9 月的一篇博客仍将 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Fable 5.1 列为 Agent 生产环境使用的模型。

Masad 还谈到企业业务增长：去年企业合同约占收入的 2%，今年约为 15%，B2B 客户贡献的收入已超过一半。
title_en: Replit CEO Claims End to Anthropic Partnership, But Sources Disagree
content_en:
Speaking at the TechCrunch Disrupt conference, Replit co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad stated that the company has ceased its partnership with Anthropic, choosing OpenAI as its primary model provider instead. Masad cited cost, partnership dynamics, and model performance as key decision factors, noting that models like Sol and Astra consistently outperformed alternatives in internal benchmarks for building applications from scratch. Replit officially announced its alliance with OpenAI in August, moving away from its previous integration with Anthropic's Claude models.

However, a source familiar with the matter contested Masad's statements, telling TechCrunch that the partnership between Replit and Anthropic remains ongoing. Additionally, a Replit blog post published in September still listed Claude models as active within its agent production environment.

During his appearance, Masad also highlighted Replit's rapid enterprise expansion. Enterprise contracts grew from roughly 2% of total revenue last year to around 15% this year, with B2B clients now contributing over half of the company's overall revenue.

title_zh: 长鑫科技预计前三季度归母净利润 1310 亿至 1325 亿元
content_zh:
长鑫科技披露 2026 年前三季度业绩预告，预计归母净利润为 1310 亿元至 1325 亿元，去年同期亏损 52.8 亿元；预计营业收入为 2650 亿元至 2700 亿元。

公司将业绩变化归因于 AI 算力需求增长带动 DRAM 行业景气度上升，产品供不应求、价格上涨。同时，长鑫推进产能建设、产品研发和工艺提升，单位晶圆产出和产能利用率提高，规模效应逐步显现。

这份预告覆盖 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日，按中国企业会计准则编制，为财务部门的初步测算，尚未经注册会计师审计。
title_en: ChangXin Technology Projects Up to 132.5 Billion Yuan Net Profit for First Nine Months
content_en:
ChangXin Technology has released its financial forecast for the first three quarters of 2026, projecting net profit attributable to shareholders between 131.0 billion and 132.5 billion RMB. The figures represent a dramatic recovery from a net loss of 5.28 billion RMB recorded during the same period last year. Total revenue for the nine-month period is expected to reach between 265.0 billion and 270.0 billion RMB.

The company attributed its surge in profitability to booming demand for AI computing, which has driven a strong recovery in the DRAM market, leading to supply shortages and higher average selling prices. ChangXin also noted that ongoing capacity expansion, improved process yields, and elevated facility utilization have significantly enhanced operational efficiency and unlocked economies of scale.

The preliminary forecast covers the period from January 1 to September 30, 2026, and is prepared in accordance with Chinese Accounting Standards, subject to final audit.

title_zh: 💡 陶哲轩：AI 证明日益充裕，数学仍要培养人的理解
content_zh:
在 Numberphile 于 10 月 15 日发布的采访中，陶哲轩谈到 AI 批量产出数学证明后的变化：数学正走出依靠个人英雄攻关的浪漫时代，证明的数量增长，人类消化、解释成果的速度却跟不上。

陶哲轩并不否认机器的创造力。他读过这批成果中的约十篇论文，有些是已有研究的延伸，一两篇包含巧妙的新思路，也有大量内容尚难理解，部分结果已因错误撤回。他批评集中发布前缺少与相关研究者的沟通，一些年轻人的研究项目因此失去原先的空间。

他担心，机器不断解决开放问题，却没有同步为学科培养新问题与新研究者。过去，证明之后的报告、研讨、合作和教材整理，会让成果成为下一代能够理解的知识；如果只有最终答案，这些环节就可能断裂。

因此，他主张转向更大规模的协作，让团队共同探索一组问题；教育中则应保留传统训练，如同使用计算器前仍需学会手算。他希望研究过程、失败尝试和思想形成的细节被记录下来，让后来者学会判断，而不只接收答案。

🔗 相关阅读：《陶哲轩：AI 正在终结数学的浪漫时代》
title_en: Terence Tao: As AI Floods Mathematics with Proofs, Human Understanding Remains Essential
content_en:
In a recent interview with Numberphile, renowned mathematician Terence Tao discussed the profound shift AI is bringing to mathematics, marking the end of a "romantic era" dominated by lone geniuses. While AI tools are now generating automated proofs at an unprecedented scale, human capacity to digest, explain, and contextualize these findings is falling behind.

Tao acknowledged the creative potential of AI, noting he has reviewed several AI-generated papers. While a few contained genuinely innovative ideas, many were difficult to parse and some contained errors leading to retractions. He also criticized the uncoordinated mass release of AI proofs, which has inadvertently disrupted research projects led by young mathematicians.

Looking ahead, Tao warned that automated problem-solving risks bypassing the crucial educational process that produces new mathematical questions and researchers. Historically, post-proof activities—such as workshops, discussions, and textbook writing—have transformed raw proofs into foundational knowledge. To preserve this ecosystem, Tao advocates for broader human collaboration and traditional foundational training, emphasizing that researchers must document their thought processes and failures so future generations learn critical reasoning rather than just accepting final answers.

title_zh: 索尼发布三款 Walkman，新「金砖」连螺丝都镀金
content_zh:
索尼更新高端 Walkman 音乐播放器，推出 NW-WM1ZM3、NW-WM1AM3 和 NW-ZX900。旗舰 NW-WM1ZM3 在美国建议零售价为 5899 美元，三款均已在当地开放预订。

新「金砖」NW-WM1ZM3 采用纯度 99.99% 的无氧铜主机身及无氧铜后盖，表面镀金，固定螺丝也采用专门的低电阻镀金处理。索尼称，这些设计用于改善接地连接；电源部分升级为双大型固态高分子电容，并沿用旗舰台式播放器 DMP-Z1 的 KIMBER KABLE 线材。

NW-WM1ZM3 与 NW-WM1AM3 配备 5.5 英寸屏幕，NW-ZX900 为 5 英寸。三款均支持 DSD 母带重制，新一代将这一处理扩展至 Wi-Fi 流媒体播放；索尼中国介绍还确认了 Android 16 系统。

另外两款美国建议零售价分别为 2999.99 美元和 1899.99 美元。欧洲市场的 NW-WM1ZM3 与 NW-WM1AM3 计划于 11 月上市。
title_en: Sony Unveils New High-End Walkman Trio, Featuring Gold-Plated Flagship
content_en:
Sony has refreshed its premium digital audio player lineup with three new models: the flagship NW-WM1ZM3, the NW-WM1AM3, and the compact NW-ZX900. The flagship NW-WM1ZM3, affectionately nicknamed the "Gold Brick," features a 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper chassis and rear cover, complete with gold plating and custom low-resistance gold-plated screws designed to optimize grounding.

To deliver high-fidelity sound, internal audio upgrades include dual large solid polymer capacitors and KIMBER KABLE internal wiring borrowed from Sony's flagship DMP-Z1 desktop player. The NW-WM1ZM3 and NW-WM1AM3 feature 5.5-inch displays, while the NW-ZX900 sports a 5-inch screen. All three players run on Android 16 and support DSD Remastering, which has now been expanded to work over Wi-Fi streaming.

Pre-orders are now open in the U.S., where the NW-WM1ZM3 is priced at $5,899, followed by the NW-WM1AM3 at $2,999.99 and the NW-ZX900 at $1,899.99. European availability for the two higher-end models is set for November.

title_zh: 腾讯混元开源 Hy Memory 2.0，记忆模型、框架与应用一并开放
content_zh:
腾讯混元于 10 月 16 日发布 Hy Memory 2.0，同时开源记忆专用模型、记忆框架和 MemHub 应用。三层能力可以独立使用，也可以组合：模型负责记忆读写，框架管理记忆的存储、更新与召回，MemHub 将记忆接入不同 AI 工具。

框架在聊天记忆之外，新增工作记忆和代码记忆，记录任务目标、已确定的做法、阶段结果，以及可复用经验和适用条件。代码场景还保存版本演进轨迹。任务继续时，系统先判断当前在处理哪件事，再找回相关决定、仍适用的经验和历史过程。

MemHub 提供 CLI 和 Mac 桌面应用，可连接 WorkBuddy、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等 10 种 AI 工具。用户授权关联应用后，可以导入历史会话、持续同步新增内容，并通过插件把相关记忆召回到正在使用的工具中；读取来源和向其他工具提供记忆分别授权。

专用模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B 采用约 3B 激活参数，面向长期记忆抽取、写入与冲突处理训练。Hy Memory 和 MemHub 的开源代码采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
title_en: Tencent Open-Sources Hy Memory 2.0 Architecture for AI Long-Term Memory
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced Hy Memory 2.0, a comprehensive long-term memory solution for AI that integrates a dedicated memory model, a memory management framework, and the MemHub application layer. The three components can function independently or together to handle memory reading, writing, storage, updating, and cross-tool retrieval.

Going beyond basic conversational history, the framework introduces specialized working memory and code memory. It tracks project goals, confirmed workflows, stage results, reusable insights, and code evolution trajectories. When a user resumes a task, the system automatically identifies the context and retrieves relevant prior decisions and background experience.

The core dedicated model, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, utilizes roughly 3 billion active parameters fine-tuned for memory extraction, writing, and conflict resolution. Meanwhile, the MemHub integration tool—available as a CLI and macOS app—allows users to sync memory across 10 popular AI tools, including Cursor and Codex, under the Apache 2.0 license.

title_zh: 微星推出《使命召唤：现代战争 4》联名 RTX 5080，散热模组也涂黄
content_zh:
微星与动视合作推出限量版 GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC 显卡，以《使命召唤：现代战争 4》为主题，将于 10 月 23 日在部分市场发售。

联名设计覆盖风扇轴心盖、正面装饰和背板，整套散热模组也采用黄色涂装。背板带有透明区域，既展示角色「幽灵」的肖像，也露出下方 PCB。

显卡采用 TRIO FROZR 4 散热系统，配备 STORMFORCE 风扇、镀镍铜底座和用于引导气流的鳍片设计。产品将通过指定合作零售商及 MSI E-SHOP 销售。
title_en: MSI Unveils Limited-Edition Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 RTX 5080 Graphics Card
content_en:
MSI has teamed up with Activision to launch the GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC, a limited-edition graphics card styled after *Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4*. Scheduled for release in select markets on October 23, the card features a bold custom theme that coats the fan hub caps, front shroud, backplate, and even the entire heatsink module in vibrant yellow.

The backplate includes a semi-transparent cutout that highlights a portrait of the iconic operator "Ghost" while revealing the underlying PCB circuitry.

Under the hood, the card relies on MSI's TRIO FROZR 4 cooling architecture, which incorporates STORMFORCE fans, a nickel-plated copper base, and specialized airflow control fins. The card will be available through select retail partners and the official MSI E-SHOP.

title_zh: Perplexity 发布两款决策模型，支持一次请求回答多道问题
content_zh:
Perplexity 发布 pplx-decider-v1.2 和 pplx-decider-flash-v1.2 两款多模态决策模型，分别为 270 亿和 40 亿参数，提供 API 及模型权重。官方称，新版本的文本、视觉表现提升，推理速度最高可达此前的 5 倍。

这类模型用于路由、标注、筛选和评分等判断任务。调用方提供背景、问题与备选标准，模型返回选项、概率或分数。新请求格式可在同一序列中处理一组问题，每道问题分别读取结果，无需逐题完成一次独立推理。

官方模型卡也给出了使用边界：对 40 亿参数的 Flash 版本，多道互有关联的问题可以合并；但若是分别评估文档、工具或函数调用等独立候选，默认每次只问一道更稳妥。

两款模型支持文本和图像输入。API 输入价格分别为每百万 token 0.02 美元和 0.01 美元，模型权重可通过 Hugging Face 获取。
title_en: Perplexity Launches Faster Decision Models Capable of Multi-Question Inference
content_en:
Perplexity has released two multimodal decision-making models—`pplx-decider-v1.2` (27 billion parameters) and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.2` (4 billion parameters). The new models offer improved text and vision performance, delivering inference speeds up to five times faster than previous iterations.

Designed for classification tasks such as routing, tagging, filtering, and scoring, the models introduce a batching format that enables multiple related questions to be evaluated in a single request sequence. This eliminates the need to run separate inference passes for each query.

Both models support text and image inputs, with weights accessible via Hugging Face. API input pricing is set at $0.02 per million tokens for the 27B model and $0.01 per million tokens for the 4B Flash version.

title_zh: 《汉密尔顿》深圳演出获批，拟于明年 5 月登台保利剧院
content_zh:
文旅部政务服务门户的全国涉外营业性演出公示显示，音乐剧《汉密尔顿》深圳演出已获广东省文化和旅游厅批准。批复时间为 10 月 15 日，演出日期为 2027 年 5 月 20 日至 30 日，地点是深圳保利剧院，报批单位为深圳市保利剧院演出经营有限公司。

《汉密尔顿》由林－曼努尔·米兰达创作剧本、音乐和歌词，改编自罗恩·切尔诺的亚历山大·汉密尔顿传记，以嘻哈、爵士、R&B 与百老汇音乐讲述这位美国建国人物的经历。原作由托马斯·凯尔执导，曾获 11 项托尼奖、格莱美奖及普利策戏剧奖。
title_en: Hit Musical *Hamilton* Approved for Shenzhen Performances in May 2027
content_en:
The hit Broadway musical *Hamilton* has received official approval from the Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism for a series of performances at the Shenzhen Poly Theatre, scheduled from May 20 to May 30, 2027.

Created by Lin-Manuel Miranda and based on Ron Chernow’s biography of Alexander Hamilton, the musical blends hip-hop, jazz, R&B, and traditional Broadway music to tell the story of the American Founding Father. The critically acclaimed production has earned 11 Tony Awards, a Grammy Award, and the Pulitzer Prize for Drama.

title_zh: 美国肯德基换用可口可乐，中国仍提供百事
content_zh:
昨天，美国肯德基宣布转向可口可乐，肯德基中国的饮料供应也受到关注。界面新闻于 10 月 16 日致电中国区官方客服，工作人员表示，中国门店目前仍提供百事可乐，尚未接到更换品牌的通知。

肯德基美国的官方公告则给出了当地切换时间表：从 2027 年 1 月开始转用可口可乐公司的饮料，预计于当年春季覆盖全美门店。

美国业务负责人 Catherine Tan-Gillespie 将这次合作列为品牌复兴计划的一部分，希望更新菜单和饮品组合，增加顾客到店的理由。
title_en: KFC US Switches to Coca-Cola, While China Outlets Retain Pepsi
content_en:
KFC in the United States has announced a transition to Coca-Cola beverages starting in January 2027, with nationwide rollout expected by spring 2027. US leadership cited the shift as part of a broader brand revitalization initiative to refresh its menu and beverage lineup.

Meanwhile, KFC China confirmed that its locations will continue serving Pepsi products, stating that no updates or instructions regarding a brand switch have been received for the Chinese market.

title_zh: 珠海航展门票 10 月 19 日开售，主展区个人票升至 600 元
content_zh:
第十六届中国航展 10 月 16 日公布票务安排，门票将于 10 月 19 日中午 12 时开售，仅通过大麦 App 实名销售，现场不设售票窗口。据南方+现场报道，珠海国际航展中心的个人票由上届 500 元升至 600 元，涨幅为 20%。

主展区公众日为 12 月 11 日至 13 日；莲洲无人装备展示区开放日期为 12 月 8 日至 10 日。高栏海上装备展示区免费向公众开放，采用网上预约制。本届不再设置主展区外围飞行表演观展区门票。

售票将分 8 批进行，10 月 19 日起原则上每周一中午 12 时放票，最后一批为 12 月 3 日。观众可提前在大麦 App 搜索「第十六届中国航展」并填写观展人信息，门票指定日期当日一次入场有效。
title_en: Zhuhai Airshow Ticket Sales Open Oct 19 as Main Venue Prices Rise to 600 RMB
content_en:
Ticket sales for the 16th Airshow China will officially launch on October 19 at 12:00 PM. Tickets are available exclusively through real-name registration on the Damai App, with no on-site sales booths available. Individual ticket prices for the main venue at Zhuhai International Airshow Center have increased by 20%, rising to 600 RMB.

The public days for the main exhibition area are scheduled for December 11–13, while the Lianzhou Unmanned Equipment Area will be open December 8–10. The Gaolan Maritime Equipment Area will offer free admission through an online reservation system.

Tickets will be released in eight batches every Monday at noon through December 3. Attendees can pre-register their information on the Damai App, with each ticket valid for single-day entry on the designated date.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜拿火箭筒，把网页打成碎片
content_zh:
在 Destroy Any Website 输入网址，网页就成了射击游戏的关卡。文字和页面区块可以被打散，角色能踩着页面跳跃、开枪，再靠喷气背包飞起来。手枪、冲锋枪、火箭筒之外，还有中子星枪和「魔杖」。

这个由 Hugo Duprez 开发、Sprite Fusion 发行的小游戏直接在桌面浏览器里运行，支持键盘和鼠标操作。可以独自拆网页，也可以开房间，叫上最多 5 位朋友对战。游戏于今年 9 月推出，目前免费开放。

[打开游戏]
title_en: One Fun Thing: Blow Any Webpage to Pieces with RPGs in This Browser Game
content_en:
In *Destroy Any Website*, entering any URL transforms the target webpage into an interactive 2D shooter level. Players can blast text blocks and layout elements apart, jump across web structures, and hover around using jetpacks. Arsenal options range from standard pistols and rocket launchers to exotic weapons like neutron star guns and magic wands.

Developed by Hugo Duprez and published by Sprite Fusion, this free indie game runs directly in desktop web browsers with keyboard and mouse controls. Players can tear apart websites solo or create rooms to battle with up to five friends.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《The Lowdown》第二季让记者卷进新案与家庭纠葛
content_zh:
伊桑·霍克饰演的塔尔萨记者 Lee Raybon，在《The Lowdown》第二季中遇到两位打乱生活的人：贝蒂·吉尔平饰演的公设辩护人 Ginger 带来一宗囚犯失踪案，汤米·李·琼斯饰演的疏远父亲则突然登门，开始接近 Lee 的女儿。

第二季已于 10 月 14 日在 FX 和 Hulu 首播两集。主创 Sterlin Harjo 执导前两集并编写首集。他在《好莱坞报道者》采访中说，第一季建立了人物世界，新一季能够更快进入 Lee 的生活，也给了喜剧更多空间。

《好莱坞报道者》的评价是，前两集虽然发生了一连串黑色电影式事件，仍保留了鲜明的幽默；吉尔平呈现的紧张感，以及她对 Lee 既警惕又被吸引的犹疑，是表演中的亮点。
title_en: Weekend Watch: 'The Lowdown' Season 2 Entangles a Reporter in Fresh Mystery and Family Drama
content_en:
In Season 2 of *The Lowdown*, Ethan Hawke returns as Tulsa journalist Lee Raybon, whose life is upended by two newcomers: a public defender played by Betty Gilpin, who brings him a missing inmate case, and his estranged father, played by Tommy Lee Jones, who unexpectedly resurfaces and reaches out to Lee's daughter.

The new season premiered its first two episodes on FX and Hulu on October 14. Series creator Sterlin Harjo directed the opening episodes and wrote the premiere, noting in interviews that Season 2 dives deeper into Lee's personal life while making even more room for comedy.

Reviews from *The Hollywood Reporter* highlight how the series maintains its distinctive humor despite a string of noir-style developments, praising Gilpin's standout performance as a character caught between wariness and attraction toward Lee.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《One Zero One》用多国人物讲述一场 AI 末日
content_zh:
《One Zero One》源自《光环》《命运》联合创作者 Jason Jones 写作的科幻口述史：约一百名角色分布在四十个国家，从各自的生活讲述 AI 崛起及人类社会的变化。Jones 与作家 Margaret Stohl 创办的 Stone Kite，将这个世界扩展为图像小说。

首期于 10 月 1 日公开，包含 80 页故事与绘画，是计划中四部系列的第一期。编剧 Eric Heisserer 曾参与《降临》和《蒙上你的眼》，画师包括 Dan Panosian、Ramón Pérez、Alitha Martinez 等人。故事设定中，人类将思考、照护和战斗交给机器，随后面临被自己创造的系统淘汰的危机。

Stone Kite 平台目前提供数字预览和纸质版预订。The Verge 另刊载了原小说的一个章节，描写人类与机器人进行气枪对战时，机器如何模仿人的欺骗、挑衅与情绪操纵；小说其他章节及跨媒体作品仍将陆续展开。
title_en: 'Halo' Co-Creator Launches 'One Zero One', an Epic Graphic Novel About the AI Apocalypse
content_en:
Conceived as a sci-fi oral history by *Halo* and *Destiny* co-creator Jason Jones, *One Zero One* expands into a graphic novel series under Stone Kite, a media venture co-founded by Jones and author Margaret Stohl. The ambitious project spans nearly 100 characters across 40 countries, chronicling the rise of artificial intelligence and the dramatic reshaping of human society from personal perspectives.

Set in a world where humanity relinquished thinking, caretaking, and warfare to machines—only to face existential displacement—the story is scripted by Eric Heisserer (*Arrival*, *Bird Box*) with artwork by Dan Panosian, Ramón Pérez, and Alitha Martinez. The initial 80-page issue, released on October 1, marks the first entry in a planned four-part series.

Digital previews and print pre-orders are currently open on the Stone Kite platform. A featured excerpt published by *The Verge* highlights a tense airsoft match where robots unnervingly replicate human deception, taunting, and emotional manipulation, teasing a broader universe of upcoming chapters and transmedia releases.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《动物城咖啡店》：跟着节拍接住老板画的饼
content_zh:
狗职员黄尚进每天加班，老板一画饼，他就得跟着拍子张嘴吃下去。另一关里，熊猫潘有闲守着灶台，把接连飞来的洋葱、土豆和鸡蛋铲进锅；猫店员白乐美则被拉上综艺节目，要在镜头前跟上节奏。

《动物城咖啡店》是一组手绘节奏小游戏。玩家扮演街角咖啡店的店长，通过顾客的故事进入关卡，听准节拍、在相应时刻按键。每关换一套场景和动作，游戏共收录 35 首乐曲，风格包括 Jazz、Pop 和 House。

游戏由一罐盐工作室开发、XD 发行，已在 Steam 发售。商店页目前显示「好评」，47 篇用户评测中有 93% 给出好评。开发团队另有制作关卡编辑器的计划，目前尚未推出。
title_en: Rhythm and Humor: Hand-Drawn Musical Adventure 'Animal City Cafe' Arrives on Steam
content_en:
*Animal City Cafe* is a charming, hand-drawn rhythm mini-game collection where players step into the shoes of a neighborhood cafe owner. Players unlock unique rhythm challenges by diving into the narrative arcs of diverse animal patrons, requiring precise button prompts aligned with the beat.

Featuring an eclectic soundtrack of 35 tracks across Jazz, Pop, and House genres, the game pairs distinct mechanics with humorous workplace and everyday scenarios. Stages include an overworked dog employee rhythmically swallowing his boss's empty promises, a panda chef scooping airborne ingredients into a wok, and a cat barista performing live on a TV show.

Developed by A Canteen of Salt Studio and published by XD, the game is now available on Steam, boasting a 93% positive rating from early reviews. The developers also plan to introduce a custom level editor in a future update.
